findings.reason: Defined canonical longest-path hidden levels, depth counting input and output layers, and restriction of the globally defined formula to an approximation domain. The cited ReLU model explicitly groups units into layers and permits skip edges [Yarotsky, §2](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1610.01145).

Aligned the active bit with strictly positive preactivation and the inactive bit with nonpositive preactivation, retaining full-dimensional pattern cells and treating identically zero preactivations as inactive. This matches the cited zero-output convention [Serra et al., §2](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v80/serra18b/serra18b.pdf).
Handled identically zero and fixed-sign constant restrictions as noncutting, and related full-dimensional activation cells to arrangement chambers.
Replaced independent tent-iterate constructions with a shared sequential recurrence and final affine skip readout, establishing the claimed linear size.
Scaled and translated general-position chamber representatives into the unit cube interior before composing with the folding blocks.
Showed that branch words distinguish the 1,024 full-dimensional activation-pattern regions, so the example compares the same quantity as the shallow bound.
